items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: O’Connell and Eberly I think were off on their own careers already.

ctx.x: Did he still have Helen O’Connell and Bob Eberly then?
No, no, he didn’t have any kind of a well known singer at all; he was going through singers at that time. O’Connell and Eberly I think were off on their own careers already.
